notes.title: Update 1.6 is live!
notes.notes:
● Toggle option added for First Person Shooting or Third Person Shooting
● Changed  FPS settings to adjust graphics the higher the FPS the low quality graphics will be and Vise Versa
● Changed coin speed and collection speed
● TPGang Enemies chase the player now when shot.

notes.title: Version 1.5.5
notes.notes:
- Updated and changed control scheme to match correct system
- Changed Sprint from holding down to toggle instead
- Fixed Smoothing Camera Glitch popping up behind wall
- Changed default control scheme

notes.title: Version 1.5.3.1
notes.notes:
- Added Zoom when aiming 
- Made short duration slow-motion during special attack and Gliding while aiming
- Fixed Jarring Camera issue

notes.title: Version 1.5.3
notes.notes:
- Double invisibility window in dodge state while auto aiming

- Added invisibility in attack state window of 0.5 seconds

- Lowered Level Up requirement from 50 to 25

- Stopped Attack interruption

- Slowed speed down for Players Special Attack and Enemy Special Attacks

- Adjusted combos 

- Auto Save when completing Jobs and defeating Bosses. 

- Made Player not invisible when shooting

notes.title: Update 1.5.2
notes.notes:
- Added Spanish and French Text
- Updated settings to be in the Handbook section
- Added 6 new Visual Effects 
- Improved lighting and performance on visuals

notes.title: Version 1.5.1
notes.notes: Resolution size matters! That's why now you can adjust to the setting you prefer for a optimized experience.

notes.title: Update 1.5 is live!
notes.notes:
* New upgrade system added for "Plunger Weapon".
* All guns have been improve for accuracy.
* Coins added for secret gun upgrade.
* Improved FPS performance
* General bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
-Added Health Regeneration when Defeating TP Gang and Bosses
-Added Save Button in Progress Checkpoints instead of Saving on Exit to
Avoid Multiple Saves
-Added PostFX Options for Performance Vs Visuals
-Added Adjustment for Music Audio
-Fixed Entrance for certain Rooms locking you out
- Minor Adjustment to rotation for Hairy Menace Enemies and Mesh Lower
Quality for Performance.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
- Added visual queues for each repair job.
- Fixed saving issue with Boss Fights you can now save after each Boss Fight.
- Added screws counter to keep track of how many you collect.
- Added cutscenes.
- Updated reflections and lighting.
- Optimized loading objects.
- Fixed camera distance.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
- Updated combo option from 3 to 4 to include finisher.
- Auto Aim added 
- Updated Performance
- Fixed Enemy Triggers

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
- Updated UI
- Added Combo Option
- Graphics Adjustment
- New Starting Position
